title: Defipulse
description:
Anyone Can use it to have an idea about what is happening for a particular Defi Protocol with the additional benefit of running the code once and check the notifications anywhere using the Push Chat app with your account just by connecting to the metamask using the account available on Push.org

**Links**
- [https://github.com/T3KRAJ/Defipulse](https://github.com/T3KRAJ/Defipulse)
how_its_made:
So One Major Issue we ran into was the Body limit of the Push Notification.They only provide data up to 500 length when retrieving once the notification is sent to see what has been sent and notify the user.

So we had a minor fix for that to just send the data one by one instead of an array or some other data structure.
